task_completion.description: The agent opens the gapminder.csv file to access the data.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A spreadsheet application (like Gnumeric) or a text editor showing the gapminder.csv file content with columns for country, year, pop, and lifeExp.

task_completion.description: The agent opens the Sugar Write activity to begin the report.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Sugar Write interface (word processor) is visible on the screen.

task_completion.description: The report contains a data table with population and life expectancy for Rwanda and Sweden in 1952 and 2007.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A table in the Write activity document containing rows/columns for Rwanda and Sweden across the years 1952 and 2007.

task_completion.description: The exact, unrounded population numbers from the dataset are entered into the report.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The document shows Rwanda 1952 pop: 2534927 and Sweden 2007 pop: 9031088.

task_completion.description: The report includes a conclusion section with the calculated absolute changes in life expectancy.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Text in the document stating the life expectancy change for Rwanda is 6.242 and for Sweden is 9.024.

task_completion.description: The final report is saved to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Sugar Write 'Keep' or 'Save As' dialog showing the file path /home/ga/Documents/development_report.odt or the file manager showing the file exists at that path.

integrity.description: The agent used the Sugar Write GUI rather than just creating the file via terminal echo/touch.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Sugar Write interface and typing text into the GUI.

integrity.description: The agent actually navigated the CSV to find the values rather than guessing.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the agent scrolling through or filtering the gapminder.csv file to locate the specific rows for Rwanda and Sweden.

integrity.description: The agent did not use a single command to generate the entire ODT file content from a pre-known string.
integrity.visual_evidence: The report is built incrementally in the Write activity, or the agent is seen performing the subtraction calculations.
